press_references.value: Ant International Partners with Barclays on Global Treasury Management with Proprietary AI-Powered FX Model

partnership_announcements.description: Ant International and Barclays have announced a new partnership to enhance global treasury management using Ant's proprietary AI-powered Time-Series Transformer FX Model. The collaboration integrates Ant's AI model into Barclays' FX hedging platform, aiming to improve forecasting accuracy, reduce FX-related costs, and optimize hedging for businesses. The partnership has already completed its first batch of intra-group FX transactions and plans to expand the solution to cover more currencies and business needs.
